questions.question: Which tone usually presents new information the speaker is telling you?
questions.explanation: A falling tone usually presents new information as complete and certain.

questions.question: A speaker says "Well, it's interesting..." with a fall-rise. What may they mean?
questions.explanation: A fall-rise often signals a reservation or something left unsaid.
answers: They have a reservation, perhaps a "but" to follow
They did not hear the question
They want to change the subject

questions.question: Starting a chunk at a higher pitch than the previous chunk usually signals...
questions.explanation: A higher key marks a new topic or contrast; a lower key marks an aside.
answers: A new topic or a contrast
